finding.claim: Two SeaweedFS dashboard panels (Objects, Bucket objects) query SeaweedFS_s3_bucket_object, which Prometheus does not have. The live series is SeaweedFS_s3_bucket_object_count, so both panels show No data.

fixes.change: the Objects and Bucket objects panels query SeaweedFS_s3_bucket_object_count, the real metric; every SeaweedFS metric in the dashboard and alert rules was checked against Prometheus, and Grafana was redeployed.
